tara: following up on the precision RFC: idea to add a lightweight fuzz-test stage to lowbit canaries (we call it 'precision-fuzz') to surface brittle failure modes before they hit traffic
anjan: what does precision-fuzz look like vs the synthetic probes we discussed earlier?
tara: different focus: fuzz emphasizes small structural mutations (e.g., bracket balance, unicode-normalized forms, numeric jitter) and targeted workload grammars (code, math, bullet lists) rather than random noise
frank: concrete examples?
tara: e.g., for code: unclosed triple-backticks, deeply nested parentheses, missing imports, or intentional off-by-one in array indexing. for chat: repeated polite tokens, trimmed system messages, emoji-heavy input. for embeddings: near-duplicate semantically-similar paraphrases
oliver: nice. how do we score the failures? need a metric easier to interpret than composite %s
nina: ops wants a single decision signal for canary automation though
anjan: propose two signals: (1) drift_score = relative KL on normalized token probs, (2) structural_error_rate = fraction of samples where top-k token sequence diverges beyond threshold. combine by max(drift_score_norm, structural_error_rate_norm) as decision_score
frank: can we use mutual information drop (MID) as a signal? if contextual MI drops across tokens that's a strong sign of degradation
tara: MID is good, call it info_drop. decision_score = max(drift_norm, struct_norm, info_drop_norm). thresholds: warn if decision_score >= 0.07, fail if >= 0.20
oliver: those thresholds are lower than usual but fuzz tests are aggressive so makes sense
nina: billing/ops: what's footprint? these fuzz runs will be heavier on pathological tokens (longer), estimate 200k tokens/day/model-family at 1% equivalent sampling
anjan: option: run fuzz only during staged canaries (not every canary). canary config can opt into fuzz_run: always|staged|never. default = staged
tara: config example we'll add to canary YAML: ```
fuzz_run: staged
fuzz_weight: 0.005
fuzz_profile_version: v2
fuzz_grammars:
  - code
  - math
  - chat-edge
thresholds:
  warn: 0.07
  fail: 0.20
```
frank: generation method: propose grammar+mutator hybrid. grammars produce valid-but-edgecase shapes; mutator applies tiny corruptions. deterministic seeds so failures are reproducible
anjan: implementation note: integrate into canary-runner as a post-step. runner will attach header `X-Precision-Fuzz: <seed>` and record `fuzz_profile_id` in telemetry
oliver: for Dedicated customers default off and must be enabled via tenant flag. add cost-warning modal in Console when enabling
nina: alerting: group into two channels: `#fuzz-warn-digest` (daily summary) and `#fuzz-fail-pager` for hard failures. keep noise low by aggregating per-model-family and deduping identical failure fingerprints	 ara: artifact retention: store raw sample, mutated input, model outputs, and a small token-diff summary. retention 60 days by default; increase for enterprise audits to 365 days on request
frank: add `fuzz_profile_id` to quant profile so we can trace which fuzz corpus triggered regressions: e.g. `quant_profile.fuzz_profile_id = "code-v2-2026-03"`
anjan: how do we evolve grammars? propose quarterly review + auto-inject new seeds when we see production postmortems referencing a new failure mode
ina: security note: avoid including any customer PII in seeds. fuzz corpus must be synthetic or opt-in labelled customer examples only with consent	 ara: rollout plan: 1) implement generator + runner hooks this sprint, 2) internal canaries only next week, 3) evaluate signal quality 2 weeks, 4) widen to public canaries behind staged flag
oliver: testing plan: run fuzz against previously-known regressions to validate sensitivity. we should ensure the fuzz stage finds at least 80% of historical FP8 regressions we have recorded
ina: ops: add a suppression/unsubscribe mechanism for canary owners to mute repeated noisy fingerprints for 7/30/90 days
frank: small API change: runtime will accept `Fuzz-Profile: <id>` header and `Fuzz-Test: true` to avoid altering batching heuristics and to route telemetry into the fuzz pipeline
anjan: I'll prototype the grammar spec and a simple mutator in python. idea: use tree-sitter for code grammars then apply token-level jitter
ina: I'll take alerting and tenant opt-in UX
tara: I'll write the short addendum to the RFC describing schema and decision flow and drop links to the generator repo in the thread
deploy-bot: fuzz-canary queued: model-family=small-llama, run=pf-0001, eta=2m :gear:
frank: one more ask: expose a per-model fuzz-sensitivity override in the quant profile so customers can tune strictness (low/med/high)
tara: noted. thanks team, sending RFC addendum tonight :rocket:
